title: Pushout of an injective set map along an arbitrary map
statement: Let $X,Y,W$ be small sets and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:X\to W$ be functions. Let $P$, $i:Y\to P$, and $j:W\to P$ form a pushout of $f,g$, meaning a colimit of their span in sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. If $f$ is injective, then $j$ is injective. No injectivity assumption is imposed on $g$.
